quality_predictor.input: Two channels: T2-FLAIR image and predicted/perturbed WT mask
quality_predictor.target: True Dice against the real whole-tumour mask

main_downstream_metric: Mean WT EvanySeg-style predicted Dice across 200 synthetic volumes
secondary_conditional_metric: Dice between the fixed segmentor prediction and the generation condition mask; reported only for the two conditional generators.
training_evaluation_leakage: None: all downstream training subsets come from data_split['train']; the fixed 200 synthetic evaluation conditions are excluded.
rank_alignment_note: Upstream/downstream Spearman correlations are descriptive because only three generative models are compared.
